title: Mayor Owens Appoints Dre'Chir Whitfield to Nightlife Coordinator
summary: Mayor Sharon F. Owens appointed Dre'chir Whitfield as Nightlife Coordinator within the Department of Neighborhood and Business Development. The role focuses on supporting safe, vibrant commercial and mixed-use districts citywide with emphasis on Downtown, engaging stakeholders across nightlife, business, public safety, and public arts sectors. Whitfield brings hospitality industry and event coordination experience from Las Vegas.

political_signal.description: Administration signals commitment to nightlife district activation and public safety integration as economic development strategy, positioning innovation at intersection of entrepreneurship, hospitality, and placemaking.
